text: きみは　もっと　つよく　なったはず　ぜひ　おてあわせを！

structure.jp: きみは　もっと　つよく　なったはず
structure.en: you must have gotten even stronger

structure.jp: ぜひ　おてあわせを！

patterns.name: 〜はずだ
patterns.explanation: はず after a verb says the speaker is fairly sure it is so, like 'must have' or 'should'. つよく　なったはず = 'must have gotten stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become' that way. つよく　なった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: 〜を (verb left out)
patterns.explanation: The sentence stops at を and leaves the verb unsaid, because 'please give me' is easy to guess. ぜひ　おてあわせを = 'by all means, a match, please'.
